name: q2-librespot v1.9
body:
320 kbit/s playback and downloads by default, with safer offline playback and connection retries. No firmware update is needed.

- Streams and playlist downloads prefer 320 kbit/s Ogg Vorbis. To choose another rate, save `96`, `160` or `320` in `.spotify/.quality` and restart Spotify. A missing or malformed file defaults to 320. There is no firmware quality selector.
- Saved lower-quality tracks upgrade when online. The existing copy remains usable until the replacement completes; offline, or if an upgrade fails or takes more than eight seconds to start, playback uses the saved copy. Downloaded Tracks lists each track once.
- Streams that cannot fit safely in RAM use temporary storage on the card. Temporary files are cleared on restart. This can increase card writes and requires free space in addition to the audio cache.
- The same music at 320 uses about twice the cache space of 160: a 2 GB cache holds roughly 14 hours rather than 28. Existing cache-size settings are preserved; normal eviction still applies.
- A downloaded queue stops at its end, releasing the audio device and allowing Q2 Pod's standby and power-off timers to run.
- Failed connections retry on a fresh session, backing off from 10 to 60 seconds. Launcher restarts also cap at 60 seconds.

Install with the Q2 powered off: unzip the attached ZIP to the card root, replacing only `.spotify/librespot`, `.spotify/run` and `.spotify/aplay.sh`. Preserve `.spotify/cache` (saved login and downloads), `.spotify/.cache-size` and any `.spotify/.quality`. Do not delete the existing `.spotify` folder. No login reset or cache-size reset is required.

Source: `shanlingq2` commit `2ea4406`, including PR #2 followed by PR #3 and the tested launcher fixes.
